messages:
Ava (Product PM): Hey team — quick design review request for the API keys page. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/api-keys-v3. Focus areas: create/rotate/revoke flows, empty state CTAs, copy for warnings, and accessibility nits. Screenshot attached: https://imgur.com/example Sam (Design): I like the layout but two quick asks: 1) change primary CTA text to `Create API key` (users expect clear action) 2) empty state should show a short use-case line + a CTA and a link to docs. Example microcopy: "Create an API key to start sending requests — you can limit scopes and rotate keys anytime." Jordan (Frontend): Noted. For the copy button we should use `button aria-label=\"Copy key value\"` and a `role=\"status\"` live region for the toast so screen readers announce success. Also we should avoid showing full key in table by default — reveal on demand. Rohit (DevEx): Agree on reveal on demand. UX idea: show last 4 chars + a masked token `••••••••abcd` and a small "Reveal" action that requires a single inline confirmation (not a modal). If revealing, show for 10 seconds and then automatically re-mask. Also capture an event `api_key_revealed` for analytics. Maria (Security): Security constraints: rotation/revoke must be auditable. Suggest we require SSO re-auth if the user didn't interact for >15 min before performing revoke/rotate for tenant-admin actions. Also show `last_used` and `last_rotated` timestamps in the list. For revoke modal copy: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any service using it. This cannot be undone." Add a small link to the audit log: "View audit log". Sam (Design): Modal microcopy tweak: replace "This cannot be undone" with "This action is immediate and will stop any requests that use this key." It's more concrete. Also add a short line under the revoke button: "If you need temporary suspension, consider rotating instead." Ava (Product PM): For rotate flow, can we show the new key once and require the user to confirm they stored it (checkbox "I have stored the new key") before enabling `Finish`? That prevents accidental loss of the new key. Jordan (Frontend): Implementation detail: the one-time reveal UI + require checkbox is fine. We'll implement with a client-generated ephemeral modal showing the key server-side once. We'll also add `autocomplete=off` and `inputmode=text` for the reveal field. Example snippet: ` ```html

Your new API key

``` Rohit (DevEx): Analytics checklist: create_key, reveal_key, rotate_started, rotate_confirmed, revoke_requested, revoke_confirmed, revoke_modal_view. Also add an event for `empty_state_cta_clicked` so we can measure conversion. Sam (Design): Accessibility nits: color contrast for the yellow warning pill is low on small text. Ensure WCAG AA (4.5:1) for body text. Also focus ring on table rows when keyboard navigating — show a visible outline. Finally, the masked token reveal should be reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and announced with role=\"button\" and aria-expanded. Maria (Security): One more for copy: when copying a key, the toast should never include the key value (just "Copied to clipboard"). And we should rate-limit copy attempts from the same user to prevent exfiltration via script. Jordan (Frontend): We'll make the toast text generic. For rate-limiting, we can throttle client copy events but also surface `copy_attempts` to backend logs for monitoring. Ava (Product PM): UX question on permissions: do we allow team-level keys with scoped permissions, or only user-scoped? I lean to both: team-scoped keys for apps + user-scoped for personal dev. We need copy that clarifies scope: e.g., badge "Team key — limited to embeddings and text-generation" Sam (Design): UI suggestion: tags/badges inline in the row showing scope + role. Hover tooltip explains exact permission set with a link to docs. On mobile, collapse the row into a stacked card. Maria (Security): For team keys, require an owner and show an "owner" column. Only owners can revoke without re-auth. Secondary approach: a delegatable permission model later. Rohit (DevEx): Empty state idea: show three quick starter templates: "Server-to-server (recommended)", "Client-only (danger — limited)", "Local dev". Each card has a short explanation and a one-click `Create` that pre-fills recommended scopes. Sam (Design): Copy for the empty state CTA: "Create your first API key" with secondary text "Recommended for server usage: keep keys secret and rotate regularly." Use an illustration that communicates security. Ava (Product PM): Final asks: 1) Can we add a small inline education panel for rotation best practices? 2) Add a small `Why show masked` tooltip for new users explaining why keys are masked. 3) Add keyboard shortcuts: `k` to focus the keys table, `c` to create new key when focused. Jordan (Frontend): We'll prototype keyboard nav. For the education panel, keep it collapsed by default. Also adding `aria-describedby` to the masked token for the tooltip explanation. audit-bot: Audit entry created: user=ava action=view_keys ts=1743178127 Ava (Product PM): Thanks all — if there are no blockers I'll iterate on the Figma copy and then we can run a quick A/B test on the empty state wording next week. :steam_locomotive: Sam (Design): small follow-up: can we use `Rotate` instead of `Regenerate` across the UI? People ask what regenerate means. Jordan (Frontend): Agree, `Rotate` is clearer. Will update code references. Maria (Security): thumbs up from security. Add a small audit requirement to the product spec and I'll sign off once that's in. Rohit (DevEx): I'll add instrumentation tickets after design updates. Ava (Product PM): Sweet — I'll post updated Figma by EOD and tag you all.
